role_or_event: Founder and CEO of a trucking company
description: Owned and operated several businesses, including a trucking company.
Finished second in the primary to Jody Hice and lost the runoff.

role_or_event: Candidate and then member-elect, U.S. House (GA-10)
description: Announced in June 2021 for the seat Jody Hice vacated; elected in 2022.
Represents a district running east from metro Atlanta to the South Carolina line, including Athens.
Defeated Derek Dooley 55.5% to 44.5% after Trump's late endorsement.
Lost to Ossoff and conceded at his campaign headquarters that evening.
